content: International child digital-wellbeing leaders: Common Sense Media/Education - research-backed K-12 Digital Literacy & Well-Being Curriculum (Harvard Project Zero), Healthy Habits lessons organized Mind/Body/Environment, grade-banded (3-5: media balance, attention thieves; 6-8: brain development, personalized media plans), 20-min lessons, dilemma discussions; slogan 'Kids Deserve More Than Lectures About Screen Time'. eSafety Commissioner (Australia): Kids site 5-12 ('Be an eSafe kid'), Mighty Heroes animated series + Robo Raven pixel game (needs 1024x768, not mobile), Cybersmart Challenge (videos+lesson plans+certificates), Easy Read booklets, conversation starters, no login (progress session-only), on-screen safety superpowers framing. Childnet (UK) resources/videos/workshops; ThinkUKnow police-backed; Internet Matters family hub. KidsHealth (Nemours): 'How the Body Works' movies + doctor-approved articles + quizzes - analog for body-effects topic.
